## Summary

What would you like to add or change?

## Use Case

Who benefits from this, and when would they use it?

## Privacy Impact

Does this change affect camera access, clipboard/download behavior, local image processing, or whether signature data leaves the device?

## Possible Approach

Share any implementation ideas, mockups, or examples.
